name: LW buyback trigger counted from a spot-balance price
summary: LW (GGGTOKEN) increments thanPrice whenever a sell is worth more than 2,500 USDT at getTokenPrice(), a ratio of the pair's USDT and LW balances, and its public receive() spends 3,000 USDT from the market wallet on an LW buyback per unit of thanPrice. The attacker skewed the pair balances with flash-loaned funds so that repeated sells counted as large, then sent BNB to the token to fire the buybacks and sold LW into the USDT they added to the pair.

loss.notes: USDT pulled from the LW market wallet by the forced buybacks in both attack transactions. The attacker contract kept 48,415.97 USDT; the rest went into the LW/USDT pair and fee recipients. The reported ~$50k is the attacker's take.

ageReset.description: Immutable token runtime; owner() is zero before the exploit and the creator's later transactions are plain transfers.

sources.note: Loss. USDT 0x55d398326f99059ff775485246999027b3197955 Transfer logs of market wallet 0xae2f168900d5bb38171b01c2323069e5fd6b57b9 (the token's _marketAddr) net -94062679733733139470673 in source-1 (block 28133286, index 85) and -78186080039775821832868 in source-3 (block 28133314, index 12), 18 decimals; the attack contract nets +34549430524604983319973 and +13866536096127220132823 and withdraws 48415966620732203452796 in 0x47349fd1a6aa (block 28133403). The attacker's other call to the contract, 0x9c32b1ed9558 (block 28120870), moves no USDT.

Root cause, anchor and age. Verified source (Etherscan V2 getsourcecode, GGGTOKEN, v0.8.6; SHA-256 of SourceCode 8e49d40df8340ec7781cb63b8a0ab41507b21317b8257d746bde14b0f5bb9e33): getTokenPrice() returns USDT.balanceOf(pair) * 1e18 / LW.balanceOf(pair); a sell whose amount times that price exceeds 2500e18 increments thanPrice; receive() pulls 3000e18 USDT from _marketAddr and swaps it for LW to 0xdead while decrementing thanPrice. Source-1 is the attacker's first transaction that moves market-wallet USDT; the DeFiHackLabs PoC (source-6) reproduces the transfer, skim and buyback loop. Age: eth_getCode is empty at block 27878238 and keccak256 of the runtime is the recorded hash at blocks 27878239 and 28133285; source-2 is a top-level creation by 0x4d93d305680eea0a358dcc022f7cdf03dfa739e4, whose 30 later transactions to the token are transfers.
